name: f4-crash-doctor
description: Diagnoses Fallout 4 crashes and mod problems. Advisory-only: it reads your crash logs and load order, explains the cause, and never touches your files.
long_description:
Your modded Fallout 4 crashed? F4 Crash Doctor gives Claude everything it needs to work out why: it finds and parses Buffout 4 crash logs, reads your load order, checks F4SE / Address Library / game-version health, detects whether MO2 or Vortex manages your game, and matches it all against a knowledge pack of known Fallout 4 crash causes.

**Advisory-only by design** — every tool is read-only. It diagnoses and explains; you stay in control of every change. Optional: add your Nexus Mods API key to let it look up mod pages for you.

game_dir.title: Fallout 4 install folder (optional)
game_dir.description: Leave empty to auto-detect from your Steam libraries. Only set this if detection fails — pick the folder containing Fallout4.exe.

nexus_api_key.title: Nexus Mods API key (optional)
nexus_api_key.description: Enables mod-page lookups. Get yours at nexusmods.com > site preferences > API keys. Everything else works without it.

tools.name: list_crash_logs
tools.description: List Buffout 4 crash logs, newest first

tools.name: get_crash_log
tools.description: Parse a crash log into structured sections

tools.name: get_load_order
tools.description: Read the load order and cross-check it against Data

tools.name: scan_game_environment
tools.description: Check game / F4SE / Address Library versions and detect mod managers

tools.name: diagnose_crash
tools.description: One-shot diagnosis: parse log + scan environment + match known crash signatures

tools.name: lookup_mod
tools.description: Look up a mod on Nexus Mods (read-only, needs API key)

tools.name: check_nexus_auth
tools.description: Verify the Nexus API key works

prompts.text: Use the f4-crash-doctor tools to diagnose the user's Fallout 4 crash, following the bundled prompt kit.
